messages.forge.requirement: Requires {{skill}} level {{level}}. Become the Bichon Artisan’s apprentice and develop the skill.
messages.forge.mixDescription: Fuse {{count}} identical equipment items: {{chance}}% success chance. On failure, the item with the most exceptional points is kept; the others are consumed.
messages.forge.mergeDescription: Combine 20 essences into 1 essence of the next tier.
messages.forge.awakenDescription: Awaken {{count}} affixes. They are revealed and take effect immediately.
messages.forge.potentialDescription: Unlock potential: attempt {{attempt}}/5. Previous results remain available to select.
messages.forge.crystalDescription: Crystal enhancement: {{from}} → {{to}} stars, {{chance}}% success chance. On failure, a {{loss}}% chance to lose 1 star. Bonuses are redistributed.
messages.forge.resetDescription: Redistribute {{points}} exceptional points. Existing affixes remain unchanged.
messages.forge.dismantleDescription: Consumes the equipment and yields matching essences one tier lower.
messages.forge.mixSuccess: Fusion succeeded. Exceptional points increased; previous affixes, growth and potential were cleared.
messages.forge.mixFailed: Fusion failed. The item with the most exceptional points was kept.
messages.forge.crystalFailed: Star upgrade failed. Star count unchanged.
